name: Malfunctions: Weapon (including explosives)
description: Breaking Your Stuff, p.10. A short summary by Neon At Home; the DLC has the full text. Import this table and edit it to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy.

results.text: Dirty barrel or dull edge: it deals 1d6 less damage. (For 1 minute)
Accident: ranged, the next Attack targets an ally within 6 m/yds of the target; melee, it slips and you drop it; a thrown explosive lands at your feet and goes off. (Right away)
Off target: -2 to the next Attack Check with it. (Until it happens)
Gunked up: it can't cause a Critical Injury through its damage roll. (For 1 minute)
Jam: it jams after the next Attack Check, whatever its Quality; a thrown explosive lands without going off (it can be picked up again). (Until it happens)

Neglected parts: a firearm's loaded ammunition is Destroyed Beyond Repair; a melee weapon or bow is Poor Quality (already Poor: Destroyed for 1 minute); a thrown explosive fizzles and is Destroyed Beyond Repair. (For 1 minute)
